text: When Mr. Brown sat down Labour MPs cheered for a full minute- and even his bitterest opponents on defence joined in. Mr. Powell devoted half his speech to giving details of plans for improving the hospital service, on which indeed the Government proposed changes will have increased the net cost of the service to the Exchequer over three years by 20 per cent.
